About R.V. Engineers

Practical equipment.
Reliable partnerships.

R.V. Engineers supplies industrial laundry equipment designed around real operating needs. From washing and water extraction to drying, we help customers identify equipment that fits their workload, space and utility requirements.

  • ✓Equipment for demanding workloads
    Options for commercial laundries and institutional facilities.
  • ✓Clear technical information
    Model codes, capacities, dimensions and utility details in one place.
  • ✓Direct enquiry and product guidance
    Tell us your load, available space and intended use to get started.
